title: Creator comfy.workflow.* tool business schemas
description: CW79: input/output definitions of the published comfy.workflow.* creator tools, read by tool_schemas.rs via definitions.<name>. Import DTO shapes mirror comfy-workflow-import-v1.schema.json (inlined because cross-file refs are not resolved by the tool-schema inliner).

importSource.description: MCP input source: endpoint omitted for local files (published input schemas carry no null).

continuation.description: Next page call (toolId + arguments with cursor) or null when complete.

capabilities.description: Published capabilities (caps.json owner JSON: workflowType, media inputs/outputs, size/duration contracts).

sourceRevision.description: Latest saved original revision, including before first publish; null only when no original is saved.

importItem.description: Library import readiness projection for this entry (session + published dims). runtimeReady stays unknown until nodeCheck runs.

nodeCheck.description: Always null on comfy.workflow.get. Node coverage is a separate explicit check, not part of this read.

params.description: Saved default generation params (video library): keys are mapping parameter ids.

capabilitySummary.description: Saved capability summary (picker lane placement); null when the entry has no saved capabilities.

legacyName.description: custom:<legacyName> generation id of a migrated legacy entry.

librarySummary.description: Management-card summary. Null for view=picker (omitted view). Library view must return this object; a null summary is a contract error for that view and is not a reason to get each entry.

workflowLibraryCapabilityDisplay.description: Card labels and capability filters only. Not an executable capabilities document. Null when the entry has no stored published capabilities.

workflowLibraryImportState.description: Card import projection. Same status, readiness and documentation structures as importItem, without diagnostics body, nextAction or sourceDigest. blockingDiagnosticCount is the count of severity=blocking diagnostics.

view.description: picker (default when omitted) returns librarySummary null and does not read import sessions. library returns the management summary.

actionLibraryClear.description: Clear all local workflow library data, including hidden entries, versions, import history and bindings. Runs alone; refuses while library writers are active. External source files, models and nodes are retained.

actionAdapterSet.description: Associate the entry's latest saved source with an installed SDK v2 adapter operation (omit adapter to clear). The package must declare the operation and list the source sha256 in its workflow-templates.json; without an association the entry offers no adapter capability.

actionAdapterPackageInstall.description: Install a built SDK v2 adapter package directory with its explicit non-secret host configuration (the SDK CLI Config without media, plus budgetMs per operation). A version is installed once; publish a new version to update.

packageDir.description: Absolute path of the package directory (manifest.json at its root).

actionAdapterPackageBindCredentials.description: Bind saved account IDs to the credential fields of an installed SDK adapter version. Read the binding revision from adapterPackage.list. Never include API keys in a workflow plan.

actionAdapterPackageRegisterModels.description: Register already installed SDK text, image, speech, or video models through the same membership owner used at installation; preserves existing choices and supports explicit retry.

actionAdapterPackageUninstall.description: Uninstall one SDK v2 adapter package version. Set force to remove workflow associations and stop unfinished local tasks pinned to this version. Workflow sources, saved editor documents and remote checkpoints are retained. Without force, active references and unfinished tasks block uninstall.

displayAlias.description: Connection-specific label. Empty string clears the label.

actionBindingSet.description: Replace one workflow preference within a connection/capability; CAS covers the scope. Other registered entries are retained. Generation category defaults update in the same transaction.
